evidence: bare_number_card: seg3:start, seg3:mid and seg4:mid show two identical teal circles, each printed with '127%' and nothing else. They demonstrate nothing.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg3:mid, two identical circles both read '127%' and both are labelled 'Billionaire wealth', while the narration says 'the S&P 500 alone grew 195 percent'. The S&P figure never appears on screen.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison composer filled both slots with the same series, so the second operand (S&P 500, 195%) was lost. Its circle form also shows no size difference at all.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show billionaire wealth +127% next to the S&P 500 +195%, correctly labelled, as a physical comparison: for example, two stacks or stock-ticker tapes rising, with the S&P visibly overtaking. Data should drive the overtake, so the payoff 'it's mostly just stocks' is seen, not just read.
